dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 6c Significant Groundwater Recharge Area in where precipitation infiltrates the ground to replenish aquifers that supply drinking water or support ecologically sensitive systems.

Significant Groundwater Recharge Areas are locations where water readily infiltrates the ground and replenishes underground aquifers. These areas play an important role in maintaining groundwater supplies, supporting stream flows, sustaining ecosystem health, and protecting long-term water resources.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
